FX-PMB-001.says: As added: Automatic, so the composition's 180 degrees and 16 samples, Vector Detail 20. The disc is smeared along its run, half a frame's travel; at frame 0 the frame before is the layer's first, and at frame 5 the frame after is past its out point, so each smears one way only.

FX-PMB-002.says: Manual, 360 degrees in 8 samples: a whole frame's travel.

FX-PMB-003.says: Manual, 0 degrees: the shutter never opens, the layer exactly as it is.

FX-PMB-004.says: Manual, 720 degrees: two frames' travel, the farthest it goes.

FX-PMB-005.says: Vector Detail 100: a vector found for every pixel.

FX-PMB-006.says: Vector Detail 0: the coarsest vectors, on a picture this small those of Vector Detail 20.

FX-PMB-007.says: Vector Detail 50: one vector for every two pixels.

FX-PMB-008.says: A drawing that never moves: the estimate finds no motion and the layer stays as it is.

FX-PMB-009.says: The textured card sliding 1.5 to the right, as added.

FX-PMB-010.says: The card, Manual 360 degrees in 16 samples, Vector Detail 100.

FX-PMB-011.says: Automatic with the composition's blur set to 90 degrees and 4 samples, its switch off: those are the ones used.

FX-PMB-012.says: Manual, 360 degrees in the fewest samples, 2: two copies a half frame apart.

FX-PMB-013.says: An Exposure of +1 before Pixel Motion Blur: the frames either side are brightened too, and the brighter picture is smeared.

FX-PMB-014.says: An Exposure of -1 after Pixel Motion Blur darkens the smear too.

FX-PMB-015.says: The holder moved 3 right and 2 down: FX-PMB-001 moved, since the smear lies on the layer.

FX-PMB-016.says: The effect on an adjustment layer above the holder: nothing changes, and the frame says why.

FX-PMB-017.says: Manual, the angle keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4: 180 at frame 2.

FX-PMB-018.says: Drawings on twos: at frame 2 the frame after shows the same drawing, so only the motion from the frame before smears; at frame 3 only the motion to the frame after.

FX-PMB-019.says: The layer's in point at frame 2: at frame 2 the frame before is outside the layer, so only the motion to the frame after smears.

FX-PMB-020.says: Shutter Angle 721, above 720. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMB-021.says: Shutter Samples 1, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMB-022.says: Vector Detail 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMB-023.says: Shutter Control written "maybe". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMB-024.says: Shutter Samples keyed to 100 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
